designationHistory.name: Sáttítla Highlands National Monument
designationHistory.indexText: President Biden proclaimed the Sáttítla Highlands National Monument in northern California under the Antiquities Act.
designationHistory.note: In 2025 the administration said it would seek to rescind the designation. As of early 2026 the monument remained in place.
